answer: An economy of AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring identity generation to a computationally intensive proof-of-work puzzle spanning a multi-epoch time horizon. Just as a physical vessel navigating a perilous voyage requires costly fuel, an attacker attempting to forge numerous illicit identities must expend massive electrical power and processing cycles. This relentless economic friction paints the adversarial landscape a dark, prohibitive sable, ensuring the cost of mass replication vastly outweighs any potential network reward.
